covers.heroAlt: PHOTO · Sandstone towers above the gorge

text.excerpt: Two days of sandstone towers and gorges, close enough to leave after breakfast.
text.intro: Close enough that we left after breakfast and were walking by mid-morning. Sandstone towers, a gorge you cross by boat, and the arch that everyone photographs and nobody manages to make look as big as it is.
